context: Mixed-version teams are the main migration hazard — a stale client writing to a migrated project corrupts both representations.
rationale: Nothing previously read config.version at all; the gate must be in the installed base before v2 flips the format, which is why it shipped in 1.21.0 ahead of the migration tooling.
summary: Format version gate ships and soaks before any format change: config version newer than the release puts the server in read-only mode (FORMAT_VERSION_TOO_NEW) instead of silently diverging
